blocking_items: User Windows device and Xiaomi 14 acceptance remain unverified; hosted Windows success is runner evidence only.
Companion V2/llama/sherpa APK/JNI and combined physical-device experience require their own exact-source evidence; the passing Android host job does not replace them.
Real Book APK SDK adoption and matching signing identity are unverified.
Real local model teaching quality, latency/RAM/thermal behavior and default GGUF selection remain device/human gates.
Live microphone, audible TTS, Spine/PiP visual continuity and physical exactly-once speech remain unverified.
Lossless receipt storage improved disk growth but leaves full-ID CPU/output growth, nondurable bounds and retention policy open.
Repository license, Spine distribution entitlement, branch-protection/main decisions and security contact/SLA are unresolved owner decisions.

MYGPT-006 is partially remediated: native Linux 85-package and Windows 54-package Python hash-lock installation/report/set checks passed at #61. Android/Node/browser/toolchain and bit-identical builds remain outside this bounded acceptance.

current_checkout.identity_source: scripts/validate_governance.py runtime Git or SOURCE_MANIFEST inspection
current_checkout.note: A later documentation/code commit or dirty tree does not inherit the checkpoint CI result. No self-referential future commit SHA is embedded.

historical_governance.migration_note: Historical candidate objects remain in the immutable original Git history and private original source archive. The public ledger contains only commit/path/bytes/SHA provenance, not original text or vault references.

receipt_storage.upgrade_rule: Stop all older processes and keep a private local pre-upgrade backup. No mixed-version access or in-place downgrade.
remaining_limits: Full result ID expansion is O(history); cumulative repeated work is near quadratic.
Existing receipt bytes are not shrunk.
No TTL or automatic cleanup policy is implemented.

source_recovery_publication.reason: The complete legacy source tree contains private vault references. Full recovery tests remain required, but public CI uploads only the closed-schema recovery summary.
source_recovery_publication.historical_source_artifacts: last_verified_checkpoint source IDs/hashes describe prior #61 evidence only, not a new source download.
